name: The licence, the acceptance and the risk
centre: the named person and the date it comes back
smallest: one condition beside the thing that enforces it
status_note: Exists on riskmandate.ai as a template file in every published vault, unissued, and as the acceptance mechanism the Risk Graph Explorer and the browser isolation vaults already run. This site never holds it. It holds the anchor nodes the licence points at, and it declares the edges that cross into it. The score has a home and this is its address.

node_types.name: LicenceToOperate
node_types.formula: -licensed_under-> one [Mandate] in U5 and one [DeltaRecord] in U6, -pinned_to-> a [GrantVersion] and a pack version, -issued_by-> an [Owner], -valid_until-> a date
node_types.note: Owned there. The organisation is the authority, the behaviour policy is the instrument, the agent is the licensee.

node_types.name: Condition
node_types.formula: -enforced_by-> an [Enforcer] in U4, or beside the admission that nothing enforces it

node_types.name: Acceptance
node_types.formula: -accepted_by-> a named person for an interval; no deny button

node_types.name: Risk
node_types.formula: -arises_from-> an [Excess] row in U6; the first node with assets in it, and the first place a score can exist

node_types.name: Threshold
node_types.formula: what a [Crossing] in U6 crosses; set here, in advance, and never by the ABP

verbs.reads_as: this licence is issued under this behaviour policy
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this behaviour policy licenses this agent

verbs.reads_as: this licence is pinned to this grant version
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this grant version pins these licences

verbs.reads_as: this enforcer enforces this condition of the licence
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this condition is enforced by this enforcer, or by nothing

verbs.reads_as: this risk arises from this excess row
verbs.inverse_reads_as: this excess row gives rise to this risk

adds: The edges are declared by riskmandate.ai in its vault, pointing at this site's addresses by version and hash, which is the three layers construction working as designed: their formulas, their bridges, our facts, and nothing merged.

provenance.note: The universe is authored in admin/build/universes.py; the matched counts and the live junctions are computed from the graph on every build.
